articles.title: The defining moments of the 2026 World Cup

articles.title: England amputee team's World Cup dream on hold
articles.summary: Former head coach Scott Rogers has said it is "criminal" that England men's amputee football team could miss the 2026 World Cup due to a lack of funding.
